Design.evidence_source: In the Known Information condition, subjects are directly informed of the state and the associated payoffs and are asked to choose between Option A and Option B directly. By contrast, in the Hidden Information condition, subjects are informed of how the payoffs depend on the state and are informed that there is an equal chance that they have been assigned to either state.
